properties: Original real std::unordered_map with char* keys, actual native hash/allocator/emplace/find/erase and native destruction; no substitute Zig map.

The map is constructed at a native offset inside the same charged Environment block. Its actual C++ size/alignment determines that offset and total allocation. No second empty-map or token-box allocation is introduced.

Each mapped move-only token holds its provider-owned native storage and copied callbacks/domain. Relative to V8's unique_ptr this is a larger mapped representation; the port does not claim native node-size or byte-charge parity.

Backing allocation has already happened when adopt consumes the token. uv_buf_init preserves its actual unsigned length conversion before emplace. A duplicate insertion has the same local ownership retirement.
Release bypasses null base, otherwise performs actual find then native CHECK, moves token before erasing node, and returns a complete owned native token. No JavaScript wrapper exists yet.
Environment destruction clears the native table before the earlier stream alias; partial initialization and final allocation retirement use the actual same single raw block.
No JS/Engine/context pointer is stored in the native table or backing token. Context is a borrowed argument only at the genuine missing-entry native CHECK.
